Downloads or exports a report as a CSV file showing the disable reasons of a device
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/downloadDisableReasons

Downloads or exports a report as a CSV file showing the disable reasons of a device.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
osTypes
string

Filter the list of entries by operating systems. The default value is null, which represents ALL OS types. The following values represent different OS types:

1 - iOS
2 - Android
3 - Windows
4 - macOS
5 - Linux

startDate
string
REQUIRED

startDate

endDate
string

endDate

HEADER PARAMETERS
Time-Zone
string

Time-Zone

400

403

OK
